f.title: Definition: adverse event (AE)
f.statement: An adverse event is any adverse medical occurrence in a clinical trial participant given an investigational product, not necessarily causally related to the treatment: any unfavourable and unintentional sign (e.g. an abnormal laboratory finding), symptom or disease temporarily associated with use of a medicinal product, whether or not considered related.
f.clause: Chapter I, Section III, Art. 6 (Definitions), item XXIX
f.applicability: Clinical trials with medicinal products with all or part of their clinical development in Brazil for marketing authorisation purposes, including post-approval changes (Art. 2); not phase IV trials or non-interventional research (Art. 3). In force 30 days after publication (Art. 99); revokes RDC 9/2015 and RDC 449/2020 (Art. 98).

In force 30 days after publication (Art. 99); revokes RDC 9/2015 and RDC 449/2020 (Art. 98).

f.title: Definition: SUSAR (serious, unexpected, suspected)
f.statement: A SUSAR is an adverse reaction that simultaneously meets the conditions of serious (see SAE), unexpected and with a reasonable possibility of a causal relationship (suspected) with the experimental medicinal product and active comparator. Unexpected means a suspected adverse reaction whose nature or severity is not consistent with the information available for the investigational product in the IB, Safety Information Summary or package insert, including a reaction not listed or not listed at the specificity or seriousness observed; it is judged from previous observations, not from anticipated pharmacological properties.
f.clause: Chapter I, Section III, Art. 6 (Definitions), item LVIII
f.applicability: Clinical trials with medicinal products with all or part of their clinical development in Brazil for marketing authorisation purposes, including post-approval changes (Art. 2); not phase IV trials or non-interventional research (Art. 3). In force 30 days after publication (Art. 99); revokes RDC 9/2015 and RDC 449/2020 (Art. 98).

f.title: Definition: adverse drug reaction (ADR); in clinical development ADRs are considered suspected
f.statement: An adverse drug reaction is a harmful and unintended response attributed to a medicinal product at doses normally used for prophylaxis, diagnosis or treatment or for modifying a physiological function; in clinical development, where doses are often not well established and causality is not well established, adverse drug reactions are considered suspected.
f.clause: Chapter I, Section III, Art. 6 (Definitions), item LI
f.applicability: Clinical trials with medicinal products with all or part of their clinical development in Brazil for marketing authorisation purposes, including post-approval changes (Art. 2); not phase IV trials or non-interventional research (Art. 3). In force 30 days after publication (Art. 99); revokes RDC 9/2015 and RDC 449/2020 (Art. 98).
